Treasury Support Officer Job at Givanas Group




        
    

        
        Givanas Group is a dynamic and innovative multi-business organization that operates across industries, providing high-quality products and services to customers in West Africa. Givanas also enhances the quality of life for people worldwide by delivering high-quality products and services that enrich their daily experiences. They aspire to be an indispensable part of consumers’ lives, ensuring that their brands resonate with customers across cultures and geographies. 

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Treasury Support Officer

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	Join our finance team to support daily treasury operations.
	You'll manage bank reconciliations, FX documentation, cash flow reporting, and liaison with banks on transaction confirmations.


What you'll do


	Record daily bank transactions and reconcile accounts
	Maintain treasury files and schedules
	Organize FX documentation
	Support cash flow reporting


What you need


	BSc / HND in Accounting or Finance
	1–3 years of accounting/finance/treasury experience
	Strong Excel skills
	Highly organized & detail-oriented
	ICAN/professional qualification in progress is a plus.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

  "title": "F&B Manager",
  "description": "Domeo Resources International (DRI) is a prolific organisation which proffers HR and Management Consultancy solutions premised on excellence and innovation. DRI analyses various organisational problems, develops improvement plans, deploys those plans and monitors the plans to ensure improved organisational performance.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: F&amp;B&nbsp;Manager

Job Location: Aba, Abia State
Reports to: General Manager
Direct Reports: Restaurant Manager / Supervisors, Bar Supervisor, Banquet / Events Supervisor, Room Service Supervisor, Stewarding Supervisor

Main Function


	The Food &amp; Beverage Manager is responsible for the strategic leadership, planning, coordination, and overall management of all Food &amp; Beverage operations to ensure exceptional guest experiences, operational excellence, financial performance, and compliance with the standards of a superior luxury hotel.
	The role oversees all restaurants, bars, lounges, room service, banquets, conferences, outdoor catering, executive lounges, minibar operations, and other food and beverage outlets, ensuring that products and services consistently exceed guest expectations.
	The Food &amp; Beverage Manager is accountable for maximizing revenue and profitability while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, beverage quality, hygiene, service excellence, cost control, inventory management, and employee performance.
	The role collaborates closely with the Executive Chef, Sales &amp; Marketing, Front Office, Housekeeping, Finance, Procurement, Engineering, and other departments to deliver seamless dining experiences and achieve the hotel&#39;s strategic objectives.


Role Responsibilities
Food &amp; Beverage Operations Management:


	Plan, organize, direct, and supervise all Food &amp; Beverage operations across the hotel.
	Ensure all restaurants, bars, lounges, room service, banquet facilities, executive lounges, caf&eacute;s, pool bars, and other F&amp;B outlets operate efficiently.
	Develop operational strategies to improve service quality, productivity, and profitability.
	Ensure compliance with hotel Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), brand standards, and luxury hospitality requirements.
	Monitor daily outlet performance and ensure operational readiness.
	Coordinate opening and closing procedures for all outlets.
	Ensure consistent delivery of world-class food and beverage experiences.


Guest Experience &amp; Service Excellence :


	Ensure exceptional guest service is delivered across all F&amp;B outlets.
	Personally engage with guests to obtain feedback and ensure satisfaction.
	Monitor guest satisfaction surveys, online reviews, and service quality reports.
	Resolve guest complaints promptly and professionally.
	Develop initiatives that enhance guest loyalty and repeat business.
	Ensure personalized service for VIPs, dignitaries, corporate guests, and special events.
	Promote a culture of hospitality excellence throughout the department.


Revenue Generation &amp; Business Development:


	Develop strategies to maximize food and beverage revenue.
	Increase outlet profitability through innovative promotions, themed events, and seasonal offerings.
	Collaborate with Sales &amp; Marketing to drive restaurant, banquet, conference, and event business.
	Develop upselling and cross-selling initiatives across all F&amp;B outlets.
	Analyze sales trends and implement revenue enhancement strategies.
	Identify new business opportunities and revenue streams.
	Monitor Average Spend Per Guest and outlet performance.


Budgeting, Financial Management &amp; Cost Control:


	Prepare and manage annual departmental operating and capital budgets.
	Monitor departmental revenues and expenditures against approved budgets.
	Analyze financial performance and prepare monthly management reports.
	Monitor food cost, beverage cost, labour cost, utility consumption, and operating expenses.
	Ensure compliance with approved financial controls and cost management procedures.
	Review daily sales reports, cash reconciliations, and outlet revenue reports.
	Implement initiatives that improve profitability while maintaining service quality.
	Work closely with the Finance Department on budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting.


Menu Planning &amp; Product Development:


	Collaborate with the Executive Chef to develop menus that reflect the hotel&#39;s brand identity and market positioning.
	Participate in menu engineering, recipe costing, pricing, and profitability analysis.
	Review menu performance and remove underperforming items.
	Introduce seasonal menus, promotions, and signature dining experiences.
	Ensure food and beverage offerings remain innovative and competitive.
	Monitor food presentation, portion control, and consistency.


Quality Assurance &amp; Food Safety:


	Ensure compliance with all food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.
	Conduct routine inspections of restaurants, bars, kitchens, storage areas, and service stations.
	Ensure food and beverages meet established quality standards before being served.
	Monitor cleanliness and presentation of all dining areas.
	Ensure compliance with local health regulations and licensing requirements.
	Coordinate internal quality audits and corrective action plans.


Inventory, Procurement &amp; Asset Management:


	Oversee inventory management for food, beverages, operating supplies, equipment, and assets.
	Monitor stock levels and ensure timely replenishment.
	Coordinate with Procurement to source quality products at competitive prices.
	Verify inventory records and stock movements.
	Participate in stock counts and inventory audits.
	Minimize wastage, spoilage, breakages, pilferage, and unauthorized consumption.
	Ensure proper storage and stock rotation using the FIFO principle.


Banquet, Conference &amp; Event Management:


	Oversee food and beverage services for conferences, meetings, weddings, banquets, and special events.
	Coordinate event planning with the Sales &amp; Events Department.
	Ensure banquet operations are executed according to client requirements and hotel standards.
	Review banquet event orders and operational plans.
	Monitor event profitability and guest satisfaction.
	Ensure adequate staffing and equipment for all functions.


Team Leadership &amp; Human Resource Management:


	Recruit, train, coach, mentor, and supervise Food &amp; Beverage employees.
	Conduct performance appraisals and identify staff development needs.
	Prepare duty rosters and manpower schedules.
	Promote teamwork, employee engagement, and service excellence.
	Ensure compliance with grooming, attendance, and disciplinary standards.
	Conduct regular departmental meetings and training sessions.
	Develop succession plans for key positions.


Health, Safety &amp; Security:


	Ensure compliance with occupational health, food safety, fire safety, and environmental regulations.
	Promote safe food handling and hygiene practices.
	Ensure employees use Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) where required.
	Monitor accident prevention and workplace safety.
	Coordinate emergency response procedures within the department.
	Ensure safe handling and storage of food products and beverages.
